applyTo: "**/*.ts,**/*.tsx,**/*.css"

Use the approved frontend stack:

- React
- Vite
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS

Follow `docs/project/MVP.md` for page behavior.

The revised MVP is feed-first:

- Universal Feed
- posts
- comments
- search
- alumni discovery
- voting
- leaderboard
- moderation

UI requirements:

- keep pages aligned with the revised page map
- include loading, empty, and error states
- keep navigation clear and responsive
- do not add private messaging UI
- do not add video call UI
